limitations: Earlier broad mixed-cancellation/saved-grant claims at 7743786b are superseded; original valid observations remain bounded evidence.
Raw incomplete or unestablished graph origins refuse; actual accessible reciprocal source graphs expand with consent.

First final reload is 2/3, retained. Exact reconstruction proves only two ordinary unlinked source Item core compendiumSource stamps and their derived sourceId attribution differ; graph/custom fields and other reports remain exact. Stable second reload is 3/3 without another acquisition.
First two reload-difference assertions omitted derived attribution; failures retained and corrected diagnosis proves exact hashes.
Intermediate bce58 actual saved drop changed source provenance in memory through core fromDropData; 416c bypasses that source mutation for saved graphs.

The 138/139 local run had a setup rename EPERM; affected setup retry is 4/4, and the fresh final full suite is 140/140. A retry without no-isolation failed to spawn and is not counted as a test result.
No backend multi-document rollback, comprehensive campaign migration, original/errata content approval, broad gameplay or release certification.
Compendium saved-graph copy context is guarded in code; no writable-compendium live copy observed. Raw data without established source cannot acquire extra records by provenance/name/coincident ID.

Historical route observations retain their own tested runtime, actor context and narrower assertions; they were not rerun by P01. Later correction observations supersede broad mixed-cancellation/saved-copy claims.
P01 checks evidence structure, linked observations and declared review dispositions, not independent truth of screenshots, runtime execution or substantive source review.
Raw reports, including failed expectations and stale labels, are immutable inputs to this annotation. No production variants, complete Gen 9 exclusion or release readiness follows.
